summary.text: Bill McCaskill is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 70, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Brian Biggs.
His campaign website describes him as a retired Child Protective Services supervisor and former Asheboro City Council member.

paragraphs.text: McCaskill graduated from East Carolina University in 1972 and, according to Ballotpedia, spent 32 years as a social worker working with emotionally disturbed children.
His campaign website says he spent over 30 years protecting children and supporting families in Randolph County.
Ballotpedia lists McCaskill as the Democratic candidate in the 2016 election for North Carolina House District 78, which incumbent Allen McNeill won.
The campaign website lists strong public schools, lower costs for families and on-time, responsible budgets as his priorities.
